text_simplified: The text speaks of the importance of *tarbiyah* (upbringing) of children upon love of the Prophet ﷺ and following his Sunnah, mentioning a story of a man who used to see the Prophet ﷺ in his dreams. It also points to the virtue of sending *salawat* upon the Prophet and *tasbih* (glorification), and the importance of teaching children these acts of worship.
